Description:
This page from the Product Environmental Report focuses on the "Recover" phase of the product lifecycle.

**Chart:**
A circular flow diagram illustrates the product lifecycle, consisting of five stages connected by arrows:
*   Design and Source
*   Make
*   Package and Ship
*   Use
*   Recover

**Call-outs and Text:**
*   **Apple Trade In:** A call-out provides the URL apple.com/recycle for information on recycling products at the end of their life.
*   **Recycling Coverage:** The text states that Apple provides or participates in product take-back and recycling collection programs in 99 percent of the countries where they sell products [note 19].
*   **Recycler Guides:** The text mentions the creation of "Apple Recycler Guides" to assist professional electronics recyclers in safely disassembling products to maximize resource recovery.

**General Information:**
The page explains the "Apple Trade In" program, which allows customers to trade in devices for credit toward a new purchase or an Apple Store Gift Card. If a device is not eligible for credit, Apple offers to recycle it for free. The report emphasizes the company's commitment to closing the loop on materials by working with high-standard recyclers to ensure environmental and safety performance.

The page number "8" appears in the bottom right corner.
